task.name: runLengths
task.description: Run-length encoding of a list of natural numbers. Every maximal run of equal neighbours becomes one pair: the value, and how long the run is. The pairs stand in the order of the runs.
constraints: Recursion on the structure of the list: no well-founded recursion and no partial definition.
Nothing beyond the Lean core library.

implementation:
/-- The maximal runs of equal neighbours in `l`, in order, each as its value and its length; the empty list has no runs. -/
def runLengths (l : List Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
    match runLengths rest with
    | (y, n) :: tail => if x = y then (y, n + 1) :: tail else (x, 1) :: (y, n) :: tail
    | [] => [(x, 1)]

  match l with
  | [] => []
  | x :: rest =>
